'''Étienne Beschet''' is credited on 4 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s as the source of the card image.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Set 11]] and [[Virtual Set 27]], sets dated 2019–2026 on this wiki. The credit on [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]] (back) is shared with [[Card Credits#Lukas Singer|Lukas Singer]].
